spans.s:
m. (-धः)
1 Wisdom, intellect.
2 Awakening, arousing.
E.
बुध to understand, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A spy, an informer.
2 A teacher.
E.
बुध to understand, causal form, aff. वुन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who teaches, informs, awakes, &c.
m. (-रः)
An awakener, a sort of minstrel who awakens the prince or chief in the morning, by music.
E.
वोध awakening, कर who makes.

Teaching, informing.
3 Awaking, arousing.
n. (-नं)
Burning incense.
m. (-नः)
The planet MERCURY.
f. (-नी)
Long pepper.
E.
बुध to know, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be explained or expounded, to be rendered intelligible.
E.
बुध to know, in the causal form, aff. अनीयर्.

Arousing, waking.
E.
बुध to know, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि)
Wise, learned.
m. (-धिः)
1 A branch of holy study; keeping the mind awake to the knowledge of the true

Intellect, understanding.
3 The holy fig tree.
E.
बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

m. (-रुः)
The holy fig tree.
E.
बोधि wisdom, and तरु the tree.

m. (-मः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
बोधि knowledge, द्रुम a tree.

m. (-त्त्वः)
A Buddha, or Bauddha saint.
E.
बोधि intellect, सत्त्व truth.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
To be informed, taught, waked, &c.
E.
बुध to know, causal v., यत् aff.
